axes.concept: Operational: keep inputs and engine output visible together inside the existing Pictures working paper.
axes.layout: One divided paper: 0.85:1.35 input/result split; quote reverses to a wide line editor and narrow totals column; gallery is a thumbnail register with adjacent preview.
axes.navigation: Inherited neutral horizontal route links; method buttons switch form/phrase/photo in place; gallery rows select an inline preview instead of opening another page.
axes.typography: Inherited Geist Sans, 24px H1, 18px sections, 13–15px controls and rows; 28px tabular count and quote totals. Geist Mono remains the inherited Sempertex treatment.
axes.density: Compact ruled rows and grouped 2-column fields, 24px panel gutters; no ornamental dashboard metrics. Phone stacks the same working groups with 20px gutters.
axes.components: Real shadcn/Base UI Button, Input, Textarea, Skeleton and Animate UI AlertDialog, recomposed into one paper; native selects and the inherited account disclosure.
axes.colour: Exactly Pictures light/dark tokens and inherited accessible control-edge alias. Accent only for primary actions and focus; neutral route selection and panels.
axes.motion: Precise cuts: paper enters 5px vertically, rows enter 8px horizontally with 35ms stagger, results arrive from the opposite edge, preview seats at .985 scale. 280ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), repeated actions 150ms; natural/subtle scale down; reduced motion removes travel and transitions.
